goal_paint_panel.claim: Match 10x10 panel(rows3-12,cols3-12) with canvas(rows34-43,cols27-36); L1-L3 completed this way.

hud_bar.claim: Bottom row 63 charcoal bar shrinks by 1 px per action (step budget ~64). Arrow keys (DOWN tested) are no-ops on gameplay.

level1_solution.claim: Paint canvas to match panel. Footprints: neutral=top5rows; tilt45=bottom corner triangle; tilt then DOWN=vertical press=left or right half. Swatch click repaints block; SPACE presses.
